acceptanceCriteria: Each verb accepts --test-repository with the TOL-V0 undeclared-name refusal.
Tests cover a separate test repository for each.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1648 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1103, head 49b927b3d, TOL-V0-060..067); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1648-witness-qualification.md Limits/Evidence. Expected: run-batch, preflight and qualify-version can target a declared obligations.testRepositories entry like witness. Actual: they run only in the store worktree.
title: run-batch, preflight and qualify-version lack --test-repository parity with witness
